name: FINVIZ_SNAPSHOT_REFRESH_LQ336_20261107
comment: ticker_snapshot_daily stopped at 2026-11-03: its only writer is stage 11 of portfolio_orchestrator.py and
stage 1 crashed on 11-04..06 (asset_type None -> .upper(), FU-007). fundamental_data's only writer is the
Monday --fundamentals lane. Pins the refresh lane: the row carries the last SESSION close (a Saturday run
dates Friday); universe = holdings + active watchlist + recent screener members, deduped, with stale
screens reported not silently widened in; a record the run did not refresh is never dated as this close;
produced_count is a READ-BACK of ticker_snapshot_daily (save_ticker_snapshot_daily swallows its own
failure and returns None); skipped_reasons partitions attempted; a dry run writes no receipt and makes
no fetch. Hermetic: fake connections, fake cache, tmp state root, no network.
